faq_heading: Central Park condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Central Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Central Park, Burnaby: 25 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 10 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Central Park rose from 18 in June to 25 in October (+38.9%), and 22 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.9% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Central Park?
Central Park also had 9 houses listed and 1 sold in October, against 25 condos and townhomes listed. The Central Park houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Central Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

31 condos sold in Central Park with a median price of $527,000 (the middle half sold between $429,500 and $637,444), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $630 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median strata fee of $471 a month. 9 townhomes sold in Central Park with a median price of $870,000 (the middle half sold between $788,000 and $938,000), taking a median of 44 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 22% sold above list. They had a median $763 per square foot, a median year built of 2009 and a median strata fee of $455 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Central Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 25 condos and townhomes listed in Central Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Central Park had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Central Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 22 condos and townhomes sold in Central Park over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Central Park sell for?
faq.a: 31 condos sold in Central Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $527,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Central Park?
faq.a: The median was 25 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.5% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
